content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the ISTC Chief Executive Officer (CEO) Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 18-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of ISTC to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ISTC CEO recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) position at ISTC is 18 September 2026. Ensure all details are correctly filled and submitted before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the CEO post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Degree in Naval Architecture Engineering, Marine Engineering, Ocean Engineering, or Mechanical Engineering, along with a PhD in Engineering from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Chief Executive Officer position?
faq.answer: The age limit for candidates applying for the CEO post is between 50 to 62 years as of 18 September 2026.

faq.question: Q4. How much is the application fee for ISTC CEO recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee is ₹400/- (non-refundable, plus bank charges extra) for General/OBC/Others. SC/ST candidates are exempted from paying the application fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the CEO role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly consolidated pay of ₹3,00,000/- with an annual increase applicable in subsequent years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the ISTC CEO recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve Certificate Verification followed by a Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent or contract job?
faq.answer: The recruitment for the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) post at ISTC is on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section on this page. It is recommended to download and read it thoroughly.

faq.question: Q9. What is the minimum experience required for the CEO position?
faq.answer: A minimum of 25 years of managerial experience in Ship design, Shipyard, or R&D organizations is required, including experience in senior or leadership positions.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from any part of India apply?
faq.answer: Yes, the recruitment is open for candidates across India, with the job location specified as Kochi.
